description: Creates and edits the app's vendors (stalls or shops selling inside the app; vendors or tokens module), their items, payouts and queue teams: "createVendor" { name }; "updateVendor" { vendorId, name?, archived? } (archiving keeps history and debt); "createItem" { name, priceCents and/or price, vendorId? }; "updateItem" { itemId }; "deleteItem" { itemId } (for good; past sales keep it). "registerPayout" { vendorId, cents } records that you paid the vendor outside Neblla; it counts once the vendor confirms. Neblla never moves that money. Queue module: "queueInvite" { vendorId, email, role? } emails a link to join the stall's team in the app; "queueRevoke", "queueOrder", "queueStations" (its kitchen). Reads: neblla_vendors_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/vendors

active.description: Whether the item is on sale.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

atDelivery.description: queueStations: the itemIds handed at the counter, made at no station.

cents.description: registerPayout: the amount paid, in cents.

emails.description: queueOrder: the suplentes, in takeover order.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

fixed.description: queueInvite: an empleado that is a fixed screen (a tablet).

itemSlots.description: queueStations: { itemId: slots } an item takes.

itemStation.description: queueStations: { itemId: stationId }, which station makes each item.

kind.description: createItem: the kind of token of price (default "default").

label.description: queueInvite: what the kitchen calls them; the email is never shown.

note.description: registerPayout: a note for the vendor.

order.description: queueInvite: a suplente's place in the takeover order.

parts.description: queueStations: true lets each station say when its part is ready.

pass.description: queueStations: true adds a pass station that gives the single notice.

role.description: queueInvite: jefe (stall boss, default), suplente (stand-in boss), empleado (staff), punto (counter screen).

sheet.description: queueInvite: also invite them to the stall's sheet in the back office.

station.description: queueInvite: the station the person starts in.

stations.description: queueStations: the stall's stations, replacing the list, each with its capacity.

name: neblla_vendors
title: Manage vendors
